# proxmox_node_dns (Resource)

Sets the node DNS servers and search domain through `PUT /nodes/{node}/dns`. Import as the node name; destroy keeps the last values.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "proxmox_node_dns" "dns" {
  node   = "pve-1"
  dns1   = "10.0.0.53"
  search = "example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.
- `search` (String) Search domain.

### Optional

- `dns1` (String) Primary DNS server.
- `dns2` (String) Secondary DNS server.
- `dns3` (String) Tertiary DNS server.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Node name.
